name: Smart Uncle Wu
description: Your AI reading companion that makes web content easier to digest. Powered by advanced LLM technology.

description.en:
Smart Uncle Wu is your intelligent reading assistant that transforms lengthy web content into clear, concise summaries. Perfect for researchers, students, and busy professionals.

Key Features:
• Instant Summaries: Get quick summaries of any webpage with just one click
• Flexible Options: Summarize the full page, visible area, or selected text
• Smart Technology: Powered by advanced Large Language Models for high-quality summaries
• User-Friendly: Floating interface that stays out of your way until needed
• History Tracking: Save and revisit your previous summaries
• Multi-Language Support: Works in both English and Chinese

Save time and improve comprehension with Smart Uncle Wu - your personal AI reading companion.
description.zh_CN: 智能强叔是您的智能阅读助手，能够快速将网页内容转化为清晰的摘要。采用先进的大语言模型技术，让阅读更轻松，理解更快速。
